title: Major Update Later This YEAR!!
message: Something big is coming to MyWeather. Over the past months, I've been working on one of the biggest and most ambitious projects I've ever undertaken—completely reimagining what MyWeather can become. The vision is to create a powerful, modern weather platform built from the ground up, featuring advanced forecasting, AI-powered weather intelligence, high-resolution weather analysis, historical weather data, interactive weather tools, future mobile and desktop applications, a developer API, and much more. Every part of the platform is being designed with scalability, accuracy and long-term development in mind, with many exciting ideas still to come. This is just the beginning, and I'm incredibly excited to share what's ahead. Coming Soon. More information, previews and development updates will be revealed soon 👀

title: MyWeather V3.00 IS HERE!
message:
This update is a bit smaller than the TCM update, but an update is an update!

This update brings a bit more lean into a dark mode themed home page, a refresh and much better design of the MyWeather Graphics, a new MyWeather Graphics Archive page, new specific word colouring on the Graphics descriptions, a new Weather Warning card design, a weather warnings map (on the warnings further info, improve hamburger menu UI and UX and more to come in V3.50 in June 10 - June 20 (release date to be decided)

title: TCM V2.00 IS HERE!
message:
YES TCM V3.00 is Here! With this new and improved version of TCM, brings a whole brand new TCM engine, which does all the calculations needed for a Thunderstorm Forecast, with a custom built engine, MyWeather has been able to shape this engine into one of, if not the best Thunderstorm Model in the whole UK! In this update there is a probability map which has a over 500 data points on the map, which a auto outlook generator and a High Resolution auto as well. And also a completely brand new 2 day ahead rain and Hail Forecast/ radar.

All TCM runs from Monday - Friday are run at around 7AM, 4PM and 9PM and Saturday and Sunday at around 11AM, 4PM and 9PM

Also this update brings a new and improve TCM Lightning page, with faster loading speeds, a custom archive (the the UK and Ireland), a completely re made Thunderstorm Warning system, live Met Office warning overlay and a lightning strike colour chooser!
